`prototypes/docs__archives__*` holds legacy projects as git bundles (`*.bundle`) plus per-bundle `.md` docs and `.png` screenshots. Catalog: `prototypes/docs__archives__README.md`. Full reuse map: `prototypes/REUSE-MAP.md` (read it before porting anything).

Todas as informações, fotos, evidências, descobertas, decisões visuais e memórias levantadas durante o trabalho no projeto Exam App DEVEM ser guardadas no board (`prototypes/board.json` / `BOARD.md` e pasta `assets/`). Qualquer informação importante DEVE ser registrada e persistida no board.
- **Goal:** UI Parity & Tab System refinement for `prototypes/exam-app-0.1.1__index.html` based on legacy specifications in `prototypes/docs__archives__*` (specifically bundle `notes-app-old-4`).

- **Automated Git Hooks:** Git hooks are configured in `.githooks/` (`post-commit` and `post-merge`). Whenever `prototypes/exam-app-0.1.1__index.html` is committed or merged/pulled on `dev`, the hook runs `sync:artifact` automatically. Enable in any clone with:

- **Automated CI (GitHub Actions):** `.github/workflows/sync-artifact.yml` runs on push to `dev` whenever `prototypes/exam-app-0.1.1__index.html` changes. If `CLAUDE_ARTIFACT_TOKEN` is set in GitHub repository secrets, CI deploys the artifact automatically on merge.

- *How it works:* Uses `claude-artifact-cli` (`uvx --from claude-artifact-cli claude-artifact publish --mode patch --url https://claude.ai/artifact/MeCzKuKCsr6fY4F8AGxnyC prototypes/exam-app-0.1.1__index.html`).

- **Mandatory rule — Zero Information Loss:** Everything captured as evidence during any task — including browser screenshots, live reference app inspections (e.g., Capacities, QConcursos, Readwise, Readwise Reader), historical branch/archive comparisons (`prototypes/docs__archives__*`), measured DOM/CSS metrics, UI/UX regressions, and architectural decisions — **MUST be immediately persisted in two places**:

1. **The Planning Board:** Add structured cards/containers and image references to `prototypes/board.json`, copy all screenshot/evidence files into `prototypes/board-exam-app__assets__*`, and regenerate `prototypes/BOARD.md` using `npm run board`.
- Alongside `board.json` / `BOARD.md`, persist deep technical dossiers (such as `prototypes/READWISE_DOSSIER.md`) containing:

- **Rule:** Before copying any screenshot to `prototypes/board-exam-app__assets__*` or referencing it in `board.json`, **always verify file size (`> 10 KB`) and visually inspect the image** (`read_file`) to confirm the UI widgets, modals, or lists are actually rendered (and not a `404` or loading skeleton).

- `prototypes/board_to_md.py` assigns an element `e` to a `container` `c` **only if the geometric center `(e.x + e.w/2, e.y + e.h/2)` falls strictly inside `(c.x .. c.x + c.w, c.y .. c.y + c.h)`**, and every element ID must also be listed in `board.json`'s `"order"` array.
- The app is a single file: `prototypes/exam-app-0.1.1__index.html` (HTML + CSS + JS inline, about 380 KB). Search it by section instead of reading it whole.
- Read `prototypes/BOARD.md` (text). `board.json` is the source of truth; never edit `BOARD.md` by hand. Regenerate it with `npm run board`.

Não substituir a evidência do boar

- **MUST** usar as **30 entradas de Laws of UX**, as demais famílias e as **86 entradas aplicadas transcritas integralmente nas seções abaixo**, com [prototypes/ux-ui-principles.md](prototypes/ux-ui-principles.md) como espelho de manutenção. A repetição neste AGENTS.md é intencional para leitura autossuficiente por agentes.

Outros itens dos catálogos, como *Change Blindness, Banner Blindness, Stroop Effect, Satisficing, Survivorship Bias, Default Effect* e *Automation Bias*, exigem classificação própria, fonte e deduplicação.
